svg.title: SD10 — Take an Item with an Inventory Button (UC05, F05; Command, Composite)

g.text: SD10 — Take an Item with an Inventory Button (UC05, F05; Command, Composite)
select "iron key" in the location panel,
buttons skip the LLM (no interpret(), no narrate())
SD03 — mode check: allows(TAKE) is false in combat
Composite: a Container adds its own weight to
getWeight() of everything inside it, at any depth;
a leaf (Weapon, Consumable, KeyItem) returns its own weight
invalid if the item is not in the location
or too heavy ("You carry 9.5 of 10 kg.")
ownerId = null here; if the item belongs to an NPC who is
not handing it over in a conversation, the ITEM event
result : ActionResult (ITEM event "took the iron key")
SD03 — the ITEM event is published (SD05):
quests advance and the inventory panel refreshes
so a button turn needs no LLM
